outgoing.name: Isle of Man
outgoing.section: Earl Harald and the kings' enemies
outgoing.excerpt: King William, the Orkneyinga Saga says, called upon the king of the Isle of Man, Rognvald Guthredsson, to fight against Harald.

outgoing.name: Norway
outgoing.excerpt: Rognvald represented the pro-Norwegian faction in the Earldom.

outgoing.name: Outer Hebrides
